unlocks.title: Echo Chamber
unlocks.joke: You `echo`ed a secret. To your shell history.
unlocks.when: shell: `echo`, `printf` or `export` with a token-shaped string (`hvs.`, `sbr.` or `s.` + 20 characters)

unlocks.title: Hist-Oh-Ry
unlocks.joke: It is in your shell history now.
unlocks.when: shell: `history` after a token-shaped string was typed

unlocks.title: Root of the Problem
unlocks.joke: You used the root token. Everyone has, once.
unlocks.when: bao: any request made with a token that carries the `root` policy

unlocks.title: Wrong Path, Right Attitude
unlocks.joke: No value at that path. Check the mount.
unlocks.when: shell: `bao kv get` that printed `No value found at` (a path that isn't there)

unlocks.title: Sealed and Loving It
unlocks.joke: The vault is sealed. This is fine.
unlocks.when: shell: a `bao` command that printed that the vault is sealed (a facilitator action)

unlocks.title: Paste Bin Energy
unlocks.joke: A secret in the chat. It happens.
unlocks.when: a fake secret string pasted into a shared channel (nothing observes a channel; awarded by hand from /admin)
unlocks.note: Left unmatched on purpose: no shared channel is observed, and the shell hook sees no pasted text. The facilitator can award it by hand.
